shots.name: Fit / Validation
shots.subject: Unfinished shirt toile on an adult fit model
shots.environment: White fitting studio, rear three-quarter close view
shots.prompt: A single realistic candid documentary photograph of a shirt fitting in a premium fashion development studio. Landscape 3:2. Rear three-quarter view of an adult fit model standing naturally, cropped from base of neck to upper thighs, wearing a plainly unfinished long-sleeve SHIRT TOILE made from unbleached white cotton muslin. A fitter's normal adult hand enters from the right and gently pinches a small amount of fabric at the model's right upper back, just below the back armhole, to check movement ease and back balance. This is a sewn muslin prototype, not a finished fashion shirt: simple real sewn shoulder, yoke, armhole and side seams; raw unhemmed bottom edge and raw sleeve ends; no polished collar, front placket, pockets, buttons, embroidery or marked lines. No random fraying except slight real threads at the raw hem. The cloth hangs naturally with modest ease, no inflated torso or distorted shoulders. Model arms hang loosely at their sides and hands are outside frame. Fitter hand has normal proportions and a believable pinch. White plain fitting-room wall, soft neutral daylight, honest fabric and skin, understated photography with ordinary 50mm lens perspective, no CGI texture. One garment, one action, no tools, tape, pins, dotted lines, symbols, text or props.

shots.name: Size / Specification lock
shots.subject: One finished navy cotton shirt laid flat
shots.action: A technician measures the chest width with a flat tape
shots.environment: White measurement table, direct overhead crop
shots.prompt: One premium yet ordinary documentary photograph of garment measurement in a clean white fashion development studio. Landscape 3:2 direct overhead shot. ONE fully finished pressed dark navy cotton shirt lies flat on a white measurement table, front button placket centered and buttoned, sleeves extended naturally toward the sides beyond frame. Crop shows collar to lower chest, centered underarm points visible. A normal flexible white centimetre measuring tape is laid completely flat straight across the chest, exactly from one underarm side edge to the other, perpendicular to the button placket. Standard evenly spaced millimetre ticks and small normal consecutive centimetre numerals from 0 at the left to about 54 at the right; the reading at each end must correspond to the actual garment side edge. Tiny real brass zero tab at the left edge, nothing floating. Two normal adult fingertips hold the tape down at its ends, no twisted arms or extra fingers. Finished shirt logic: ordinary pointed collar, one breast pocket, closed placket, small buttons, clean stitching, no raw edges, basting, dotted overlays or drawn marks. Plain white table occupies the background, soft neutral white daylight, natural restrained cotton texture and photographic grain, no glossy CGI, no beige cast, no paper, rulers or other props. One clear measurement action only.
